subject: Replace: Senior Infra Engineer (attrition) — headcount & comp sign-off
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Replace: Senior Infra Engineer (attrition) — headcount & comp sign-off

Hi Laura,

Heads-up — Jason Park in Infra resigned effective 2/1; we patched for a month but the role is now critical again. I am requesting approval to fill the vacated Senior Infrastructure Engineer slot on the Serving Runtime team. A few important context points:

- Reason: attrition (voluntary). Jason owned model I/O and KV cache stabilization.
- Scope shift: since Jason’s hire last year the scope now includes low-latency KV cache routing for multi-tenant pools; this work aligns to an IC4 level.
- Proposal: backfill the headcount but re-level to IC4 (Senior -> Staff-equivalent scope).
- Compensation: recommended band for IC4 in infra is base 170k–200k; target offer = base 180k + 20% bonus target (total cash ~216k); open to up to 200k base in a tight market.

Attached: JD_Senior_Infra_2026.pdf and comp_band_analysis_20260212.xlsx with run-rate impact. High-level ask: sign off on the re-level + comp band and confirmation we can use the existing headcount slot (or route me to who owns the slot). We’d like to engage Emma at TalentBridge immediately — they have a shortlist ready and charge a standard contingency.

Can you confirm in principle so I can start offers? If we need a business-case doc, I can add a short one-pager today.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
(attachment: JD_Senior_Infra_2026.pdf, comp_band_analysis_20260212.xlsx)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Replace: Senior Infra Engineer (attrition) — headcount & comp sign-off

Marissa —

Thanks for the context and for flagging the re-level rationale. Approve in principle to backfill with a higher-band if the business case supports it. A couple of requirements before you proceed to offer:

1) Please add a 1-page business-case (impact to latency/cost, key deliverables for 90/180 days).
2) Confirm run-rate delta to the org budget (finance needs a concrete number).
3) Loop in Compensation for a quick calibration note (I’ve CC’d Stephanie).

If you can get the one-pager and the run-rate impact to Evelyn, I’ll give final sign-off for the re-level this week. Otherwise we can proceed at IC3 band and reserve the IC4 request for next quarter.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

Marissa/Stephanie —

I reviewed the comp spreadsheet you attached. We need the following to clear the re-level from a budget perspective:

- Exact run-rate delta (comp + benefits + payroll taxes) for FY26 (annualized).
- Cost center and GL code to charge the increase.
- Whether this will be a new headcount add or reallocation from another team (internal transfer frees up budget).
- Recruiter fee estimate (if using TalentBridge, include % or flat fee).

Quick calc: moving from a ~150k run-rate (IC3) to ~216k total cash (IC4 target) is ~66k incremental annual. Finance can absorb up to two such deltas within the hiring pool this quarter but we need to tag it to a cost center. If you can confirm the cost center and provide the one-pager, we’ll fast-track.

Also confirm if there’s a preferred start date (for payroll timing).

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Finance Planning & Analysis
Redwood Inference

Thanks, Evelyn. Added the one-pager and headcount plan to the headcount_reorg sheet (see attachment headcount_reorg_20260213.xlsx) and the Drive link below. Highlights:

- Run-rate delta (FY26 annualized): +$64,800 (this accounts for a 5% benefits+tax load).
- Cost center: ENG-INFRA (GL 4301).
- Proposed funding: reallocate the open slot from Search Team (we have one repo lead role on pause); this is an internal transfer of headcount, not an increase in net headcount.
- Recruiter fee: TalentBridge contingency 18% of first-year base (if we place at 180k fee ~32.4k). Emma is on this thread to confirm timeline and fee structure.
- Desired start: target onboarding 2026-04-01 to align with Q2 sprint cadence.

Action items I plan to run this morning:
1) Send the formal offer letter template to TalentBridge to prepare (conditional on approvals).
2) Post JD and run a 5-day internal transfer window (Laura suggested internal first).
3) If no internal transfer, extend to external pipeline and engage Emma for rapid submittals.

Please confirm and I’ll proceed to create the Workday req (WorkdayREQ-4521) and routing.

—
Marissa Cole
Director, Serving Runtime
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

- We tag this to ENG-INFRA (GL 4301) and use the Search Team slot as you proposed (so no net new headcount).
- Offer runway: cap base at $200k. Total cash target should not exceed ~$240k (base + bonus).
- Run the 5-day internal transfer window first; if no internal move, proceed with TalentBridge and copy Compensation on the final offer.

Next steps for you: please post the internal JD today, create the WorkdayREQ-4521 with ENG-INFRA cost center, and share the final offer template with Compensation for sign-off. Once Comp confirms, Marissa you can proceed to extend an offer.
